Drawn to scale: the panel runs from half a metre to two, and the pad sits at chest height beside it.

Side elevation

Heights from the floor. The bands are the panel face.

Side elevation of the cabinet, drawn to scale. The panel face runs from 0.50 m to 2.00 m in seven zones: Z0 Crown, 2.00 to 1.86 m; Z1 Plate, 1.86 to 1.80 m; Z2 Replay, 1.78 to 1.31 m; Z3 Run block, 1.29 to 1.04 m; Z4 Call, 1.03 to 0.87 m; Z5 Runway, 0.87 to 0.55 m; Z6 Base strip, 0.55 to 0.50 m. The pad sits beside the panel at 1.13 to 1.43 m and the payment reader at 0.98 m. Head range 1.60 to 1.90 m and eye range 1.45 to 1.70 m are shaded across the room. From the pad at 0.6 m the crown is 31 degrees up; stepped back at 1.5 m it is 13.5 degrees up. From the queue decal at 3 m the whole column is 28 degrees tall. A spectator 3.5 m back, eye 1.60 m, sees over a 1.75 m player only down to 1.86 m, canvas y 352. From 4.5 m the panel is 19 degrees tall. A child or wheelchair user at 1.5 m, eye 1.1 to 1.2 m, sees the crown 25 to 28 degrees up.
